entities.name: Arthur Nicholas Tafoya
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Arthur Nicholas Tafoya was an American prelate of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as the third bishop of the Diocese of Pueblo in Colorado from 1980 to 2009. His resignation as bishop was accepted by Pope Benedict XVI on October 15, 2009.
